description:
Moves the CLI's repository-opening prelude into one library function that returns a ready executor and its retained mutation session, so `main.rs` makes no storage or discovery call of its own.

## Background

`run()` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` opens the repository inline before dispatch:

- discovers the data root (`JIT_DATA_DIR`, `jit init`, `discover_recovery_jit_dir` for recovery-dispatched commands, `discover_jit_dir` otherwise, with a `<cwd>/.jit` fallback);
- detects `WorktreePaths::detect_for_data_root` and takes the linked-checkout write decision;
- constructs `JsonFileStorage::new`, calls `configure_worktree_paths` and `discover_repository_layout`;
- opens the mutation session: an unretained `RepositoryStateStore::open_mutation_session` for claim-coordinating commands, `open_and_retain_mutation_session` otherwise, mapping a leftover-record failure under `jit recover` to a recovery failure;
- builds `CommandExecutor::new(..).with_layout(..).with_worktree_paths(..)`;
- calls `storage.validate()` for every command except `init` and `profile list`/`show`.

The server repeats part of this in `crates/server/src/main.rs`. Every step is library work, and its order is behaviour (the write-policy refusal precedes any lock or write; recovery precedes validation).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A public library function takes the invocation facts the prelude reads (working directory, data-dir override, whether the command is init, recovery-dispatched, claim-coordinating or validation-exempt, and the write override) and returns the executor, the retained-session guard and the recovered-record count, performing the steps above in today's order.
- [hard] REQ-02: `main.rs` opens the repository only through that function and makes no `JsonFileStorage`, `RepositoryStateStore`, discovery, worktree-path or `validate` call.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test of the function (for example `test_open_repository_validates_except_for_exempt_commands`) shows the validation exemption and the retained session, and the existing startup, recovery, linked-checkout and init suites pass unweakened.

## Notes

- 0f8efc37 later adopts this function for the server; the server is unchanged here.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1, D-11); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Library repository bootstrap for the CLI
